narrative.overview: This portfolio behaves like a working instrument for inspecting software work. Near-black space, etched rules, readouts, and signal traces create a technical environment, while oversized off-white and acid-lime type keeps the human author unmistakable.

rules.name: The Active Signal Rule
rules.body: Lime means active, selected, live, or actionable. Do not scatter it as decoration.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Space Grotesk for what Duuk says; use DM Mono for what the system measures.

dos: Do use acid lime only for active signals, selected navigation, and clear actions.
Do pair public repository data with human explanation and honest fallback states.
donts: Don't add gradients, glassmorphism, generic glowing borders, or rounded card grids.
Don't turn activity counts into unsupported performance claims.
